answer: A practical anti-Sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, and peers rate its work over time. New identities start behind a velvet rope, with limited access until they build a track record, so spinning up thousands of sock puppets costs real capital and time. Like yarrow spreading slowly across a field, reputation grows gradually and cannot be bought in bulk. A shared nebula of attestations lets honest agents vouch for each other, while one proven fraud burns the attacker deposit and every linked identity at once.
